title: Arteria
synopsis: Arteria is a city-building and traffic simulation game. Build roads, intersections and tram lines, and watch the city grow on its own along the routes you lay down. Clear traffic jams, plan efficient transport and turn a small village into a thriving metropolis.

title: Kinetile
synopsis:
Kinetile is a 3D physics puzzle game about getting one rolling ball to the finish. Drag arrows, jumps, teleports and bouncers into place, then press Start: the board locks and your plan plays out. Watch the ball clear a gap, ricochet into a turn and emerge from a teleport exactly where you planned.

The game has 56 handcrafted levels in two packs. CLASSIC PATHS introduces the tools across 28 levels, from the first turns to routes combining long jumps, teleports and gates controlled by buttons. FORGED PATHS adds 28 puzzles with denser boards, where buttons set sliding platforms in motion and fill gaps in a cascade, so a bridge has to slide into place before the ball arrives.

Infinity mode generates a new puzzle every time on Normal or Hard difficulty. Each board has a seed code that can be copied to replay it or to challenge a friend to solve the same board.

There is no timer or move limit. Stop a run or let the ball fall, and the tiles return to the arrangement you prepared, ready to adjust and try again.

title: Cat Simulator
synopsis: Cat Simulator is an adorable game where you play as a mischievous little cat! Explore cozy rooms, interact with all kinds of objects, pull playful pranks, and knock things over just for fun. Jump around, collect stars, and unlock new rooms to continue your curious adventure. Ready to cause some cute chaos?

title: Dongda Gangster
synopsis: DONGDA Gangster is a live-action interactive narrative game based on the popular Chinese IP Northeast Past, set in Northeast China during the 1980s and 1990s. Players take on the role of Zhao Hongbing, navigating the criminal underworld, shifting power struggles, romance, and bonds of brotherhood. Directed by the original novel's author, Kong Ergou, the game features returning cast members from the screen adaptation. Player choices influence relationships, story branches, and multiple possible endings. The game recreates the era through detailed environments and explores themes of loyalty, betrayal, friendship, and ambition.

title: Path of Exile: Covens of Umbra
originalTitle: Path of Exile: Covens of Umbra
synopsis: Disrupt dark magicks and put an end to the powerful witchcraft of the Coven Queen in Path of Exile: Covens of Umbra.

title: Last Gambit
synopsis: Build an impossible army: knights that become unicorns, queens that cross the edges, phoenixes that rise again. Lead it through a roguelite Story of bosses, merchants and perks that bend the rules, then put it to the test online.

title: A.N.S.I.A.
synopsis: It's your first day at ANSIA. Review citizens' paperwork according to regulations that change every day, growing more absurd by the minute. A satire of Italian bureaucracy inspired by Papers, Please, with 4 different endings.

title: Beekeeper Simulator
synopsis: Beekeeper Simulator puts you in the shoes of a dedicated beekeeper, where you'll care for buzzing hives, harvest a variety of honey types, and expand your operations to build a thriving beekeeping empire. Nurture your bees, optimize your apiary, and turn your passion into profit!

title: Dark Workshop Simulator
synopsis: Dark Workshop Simulator is a first-person dark fantasy shop simulator. The player runs an emporium serving adventurers, alchemists and monsters: ordering from suppliers, stocking shelves, setting prices and fulfilling contracts. Potions, blades and tomes are crafted at alchemy, forge and library stations by tracing sigils, and crafters can be hired to work them. Grime builds up over time and attracts customers, thieves must be caught, and hostile creatures are fought off with a hammer. World events such as plagues, wars and edicts reshape market demand. The shop expands with new rooms, zombie staff and a Grimoire skill tree of permanent upgrades.

title: Moga TD
synopsis: Moga TD is a cooperative tower defense game for up to four players. Each player controls a builder with its own race of towers and defends one corner of a shared board against 41 waves of creeps, ending with the Orc Warlord. Players share one pool of lives, earn Gold to build and upgrade towers, and must coordinate their defenses to win. Online co-op runs through Steam lobbies.

title: I Walk Among Zombies Vol. 1
synopsis: Yuusuke awakens in a world where zombies have overrun civilization, but finds that the zombies don't attack him. How will Yuusuke take advantage of his new situation, and what will he discover? Enjoy this kinetic visual novel's twist on the classic zombie survival genre.

title: Logosmancer
synopsis: A 5v5 wizard battler where every spell is cast with your voice. Yell FIREBALL, FREEZE, FLY, TRANSFORM or FART to fight in King of the Hill, Team Deathmatch and Free-for-All, or survive co-op waves in Sandbox.

title: Knurlworm
synopsis: Knurlworm is a short character-driven game where every visual asset is made from real woodcut stamps pressed onto real paper. Watch a lone Carver's story unfold print by print as he searches for a mythical worm said to be able to change a person's fate. The Knurlworm.

title: Pawhold: Idle Desktop Cat Space Game
originalTitle: Pawhold: Idle Desktop Cat Space Game
synopsis: Somewhere out there, an AI keeps generating worlds and enemies to conquer mankind. Your cats are on the task. An idle pixel squad shooter that lives along the bottom of your screen while you work: four cat commandos fight, you click to help, bank the bounty and refit the crew.

title: No More Monsters
synopsis: It's time to challenge the monsters of Arvelia! Become one of the world's mightiest mages, slay thousands of creatures, and claim their power. They thought this world belonged to them. Prove them wrong. They used to be the hunters. Now they're the prey. No More Monsters!

title: Piercing
synopsis: PIERCING is a rhythm-action game where you smash every panel to the beat. Fail, and the Contract forces you to give your childhood friend a piercing.

title: Kinsoku Ryokan
synopsis: Follow the ever-changing taboos, complete your exorcism missions, and make it back alive. A horror action game featuring the story of Satomi, an apprentice shrine maiden, and online play for up to 8 players.

title: QUTAS67: Qubic Ultimate Tap Adventure Simulator 2067
originalTitle: QUTAS67: Qubic Ultimate Tap Adventure Simulator 2067
synopsis: Every criminal starts somewhere. You start in a dumpster. Welcome to Miami, 2067, where the economy is a joke and you’ve decided to become the punchline. Click to earn cash, upgrade your Click Power and work your way through 20 locations, from parking lots to banks and museums. Your goal? Stealing The Legendary Game the whole world has been waiting for. Apparently, asking nicely wasn't an option.

title: Hellterns
synopsis: A chaotic co-op work sim set in Hell for 1–4 players. Catch sinful souls, put them through absurd machines, stamp their papers, and send them to Heaven before your shift ends. Fires, brawls, and write-ups included.

title: Goblin and Glory
synopsis: Build your goblin crew, upgrade your sword, and fight through 10 dungeons! Goblin & Glory is a pixel-art clicker game with auto-attacking helpers, relic choices, and 60-second boss battles. Earn prestige, unlock permanent abilities, and return stronger with every run.

title: We March as One
synopsis: Start with a few shapes and build an army tens of thousands strong. Paint your troops onto the battlefield and send them to war against enormous hordes in this incremental auto battler where every unit is individually simulated.

title: Business Tycoon
synopsis: Build a business empire across the United States. Create companies, open and upgrade assets. Expand across industries, dominate markets, control a growing share of the economy, and build a trillion-dollar fortune.

title: Zombies Aren't Real
synopsis: Zombies aren't Real is a horde-defense, strategy game where you deploy military forces in an attempt to quell a quick-spreading zombie infection and save as many civilians as you can!

title: Blowhole
synopsis: You're a dolphin. Your job: make everything sparkle by spitting high-pressure water. 1–6 players, seagulls with a grudge, crazy modifiers and absolutely zero professionalism.

title: Escape Your Boss
synopsis: Escape Your Boss is a 2D pixel-art action platformer. Jean-Michel, an overworked accountant, wants to leave the office in time to watch the France–Brazil match at 8:45 PM, but his boss has locked down the whole floor. Dressed as a ninja, he fights his way down Megacorp Tower floor by floor, facing coworkers, security guards and office-themed bosses. The campaign can be played solo or in online co-op with up to four players. The game also includes a level editor and bonus modes.

title: Battlegenics
synopsis: A unique roguelike word fusing mutant breeding game! Fuse the monsters and the words into one creature. Form an army of mutants and battle the world! Or play with a friend and fuse parts together.

title: My Little Empire: Cyber Lounge
synopsis: Build your own computer club from an empty lot: rows of gaming PCs, console and VR corners, a bar and a kitchen. Hire staff, keep gamers happy, deal with 21 city factions — and don't forget to pet Luna, the club cat.

title: Zombie Crawlers
synopsis: Crawl through a haunted mansion and gun down the undead with a deck of cards! Zombie Crawlers a 3D first-person roguelite deckbuilder where your deck is your boomstick. Explore the mansion, uncover its secrets, and face the neverending horrors behind each door.

title: The Eggsortist
synopsis: A chicken possessed by the Devil has laid 4,266 colored eggs in a barn, but 666 of them are demonic eggs in disguise! Sort the eggs, find the evil impostors, and burn them before they hatch and doom the world.

title: Parcel Inspector Simulator
synopsis: Parcel Inspector Simulator is a first-person inspection sim set on the night shift of a transit post office in 1962. Every parcel that crosses the desk is weighed, X-rayed, checked under a UV lamp, listened to with a probe and looked up in the terminal, then stamped: approve, return to sender, hold, dispose or confiscate. Regulations change from night to night, wages pay for desk upgrades and for a brother's sanatorium bills, and a 20-night story campaign with seven endings follows a favour that somebody upstairs keeps asking for. After the campaign the shifts go on as endless nights with special conditions.

title: Yoyo Blade
synopsis: Master a tethered blade in a mouse-only incremental action game. Throw it, build up speed, and upgrade it to fight back waves of enemies before corruption consumes your world.

title: Bannerlings
synopsis: Build an unstoppable army in this strategy roguelite auto-battler. Fuse your Bannerlings, create powerful emblem synergies, and overcome unpredictable encounters on the road to the final boss.

title: CarCrash.Tube: Car Crash Simulator
synopsis: Create crazy crash scenarios, wreck cars, and capture the chaos! Share your best videos on your channel, gain new followers, and increase your earnings. Buy new vehicles and equipment, create bigger crashes, and take your CarCrash.Tube channel to the top!

title: Frontier Tale
synopsis: Frontier Tale is a cozy adventure farming game that blends extraction-style gameplay with town building. Forge weapons, explore a charming cel-shaded fantasy world, gather rare resources, recruit unique companions, and build your dream frontier from the ground up.

title: Dusteroids
synopsis: Dusteroids is a satisfying space-themed incremental game. Fill the screen with bullets, destroy asteroids, upgrade your ship & do it all again! Do you have what it takes to seek the stars?

title: Provinces
synopsis: Provinces is a compact turn-based strategy game about leading your one and only army across a medievalish war board. Roll for Action Points, cut enemy supply lines, storm rival capitals and watch your tiny soldiers deal with the consequences in fast, automatic battles.

title: Dice Hoarder
synopsis: Dice Hoarder is a cozy organizing game where you restock a mysterious dice shop. Sort every die in the shop, match them into complete seven-piece sets, and uncover what is hidden behind your new job.

title: 10 Million Pixels
synopsis: Mine through millions of pixels to find the one golden pixel. A mesmerizing incremental game about exploration and erosion.

title: Extract Survivors
synopsis: Extraction survivors-like meets deep ARPG Loot. Fight endless hordes across deadly floors, extract, then roll, gamble, and upgrade gear across 10 tiers of modifiers and powerful Uniques to forge a game-breaking build. One life. Permadeath. Infinite loot. How deep can you fall?

title: Warrior Quest
synopsis: Warrior Quest is a single-player, text-driven dark-fantasy RPG where old-school dungeon crawling meets next-gen, free-form, offline AI diplomacy. Fight, sneak, negotiate in your own words, recruit unlikely companions... and whatever you do, roll well.

title: Epoch Vault
synopsis: Bring life back to a world shattered by Earth’s greatest mass extinction. Discover ancient creatures, watch ecosystems recover, and trace life’s journey from the survivors to the rise of the first dinosaurs in an atmospheric idle game set in the Triassic.

title: Satelital
synopsis: A rule-discovery puzzle game where you place alien symbols on a grid. Uncover their logic as you journey through an atmospheric solar system.

title: Node Zero
synopsis: Investigate system failures, trace corrupted infrastructure, and keep the node alive before stability reaches zero. NODE ZERO is an interface-driven psychological horror game where something inside the system is learning how you work.

title: Grandma Left Me A Building
synopsis: A cozy apartment management sim where you restore the ruined building your grandma left you. Find tenants, collect rent, upgrade the place. But don't make the mistake of having a midnight guitar-shredding elf and a philosophy-lecturing yeti as neighbors. Endless requests, sweet chaos await.

title: ChickenPlaguePolice
synopsis: A deadly Chicken Plague has destroyed the world. As a guard of humanity’s last safe zone, you must inspect survivors seeking refuge and identify the infected. One mistake could doom the entire community, so examine everyone carefully before allowing them inside.

title: Sol One
synopsis: A grounded open-world survival crafting game where you're stranded alone on Mars. Explore the red planet, extract resources, build a pressurized base, manage oxygen, power, and food, and construct the rocket that's your only way home.

title: Fancy Farm Brawl
synopsis: Closed Playtest Now Live! Mix relaxing farming & tower defense. Early testers average over 98 minutes per play session. Click Request Access on store page to apply for limited slots.

title: Hands Over
synopsis: HANDS OVER is a 5-player co-op horror game where harmless challenges become cruel tests of luck and nerve. Bluff, sabotage your friends, play dirty, and stay at the table longer than anyone else.

title: Deathly Delights
synopsis: Forge new friendships, banish the darkness, and illuminate your surroundings as you unravel the truth behind a town stuck in Limbo during Hallows Eve.

title: Slay the Q
synopsis: Roguelike deck builder where you summon creatures to fight for you. Gain gold, buy magical Artifacts, enchance Cards with Runes, and create powerful combinations.

title: Warota: I Live Next to The Demon King's Castle LOL
originalTitle: Warota: I Live Next to The Demon King's Castle LOL
synopsis: 【Village-Building Action RPG】 Saved by a goddess, you arrive in a ruined world ruled by the Demon King. Gather resources, build your village, swap hats to change classes and give villagers their roles. But one night, the Idol Demon King holds a Live next door...and monsters come pouring in!?

title: Potted Pets
synopsis: Potted Pets is a cozy farming and pet simulator, with an adorable cast of living plant pots. Spend time cultivating a personal garden while growing a personal relationship with your collection of “Potted Pets!” Sit down for a relaxing, customizable experience that brightens up your busy day!

title: Powerfuel
synopsis: Powerfuel is an action FPS set in a gritty dieselpunk world. Play as the legendary ex-criminal known as the Cricket, and harness the mystical properties of powerfuels. Fight your way through the gangs of New Lyon and shed light on the conspiracy plaguing the city.

title: Hot Meals Fast Wheels
synopsis: A co-op cooking game where small mistakes quickly turn into chaos. Go shopping, cook in your food truck, and drive through the city to deliver orders on time.

title: Backseat Champions
synopsis: Manage your driver in short, tactical races. Rapidly choose from dozens of upgrades each race. Use tire compounds to shape your strategy. Machine-learned drivers make every race unpredictable. Can you become the Champion?

title: RatSpiderFrog
synopsis: A cursed auto-battler where you take control of a bunch of rats to fend off enemy attacks. Crossbreed them. Grill them. Feed them. Make them POWERFUL!

title: Rasen
synopsis: Strike with precision, time your deflects and fight flawlessly to your own rhythm. Step into atmospheric PvP or PvE arena duels and fast-paced clashes with a variety of lethal characters.

title: Mellings
synopsis: Mellings are striking back! Control an excavator and grab resources to bring them back to the burrow, defend yourself with various cannons while harvesting, and destroy huge buildings and bosses!

title: Cannon Keep
synopsis: Build your city block by block and defeat waves of mechs in this tower defense roguelike! Combine powerful cannons with unique effects to survive the unforgiving wasteland and explore the underground to gather resources and find powerful relics.

title: Drawquarium
synopsis: Draw your own fish and unlock new ways to decorate your aquarium. If you feed them well, they will gain a metallic shimmer as they age. Will you be the one to raise a golden fish in this relaxing sandbox experience?

title: Referee Life Simulator 2026
synopsis: A realistic referee simulator! Show cards, use VAR, control matches, and rise through your referee career!

title: Netherwake
synopsis: Experience a nerve-racking adventure as a thick, dark fog begins to roll into the small town from the surrounding forests, and with it come ancient, cosmic beings from outside our reality. Try to survive and pray that you will one day see the sunlight again.

title: Exodus Core
synopsis: Command an elite squad of mechs and fight back against the alien invasion. Every mission is a challenge. Exodus Core features turn-based combat, mech upgrades and modifications, squad management, and tactical warfare.

title: UnderMire
synopsis: UnderMire is a 1-4 player first person co-op roguelite adventure where you descend into a magical, ever-changing bunker to confront the dark forces that lie within. Battle fear-fueled monsters, SMUSH everyday junk into magical weapons, master evolving tools, complete tasks from a cantankerous spirit cat, and survive the chaos alone or with your friends using proximity voice chat.

title: Menes: The Chainbreaker
synopsis: Embark on a perilous journey as Menes, an angel with no memory, sent to free a mysterious prisoner from a forgotten realm. Uncover dark secrets, face relentless enemies, and shape the fate of a universe on the brink of collapse. A platformer adventure awaits, with very similar vibes to Soul Reaver .

title: Deeplanders
synopsis: DEEPLANDERS is a relaxing, minimalist strategic building game where you must satisfy the needs of the Deeplanders to populate the depths. Explore, build, and decorate your own underground kingdom... and when you're ready, embark on a journey to new, unexplored depths!

title: Sloppy Forgeries
synopsis: Sloppy Forgeries is a fast-paced competitive painting game. Practice your skills by butchering iconic masterpieces in one of the few drawing games that measures accuracy pixel-by-pixel in real-time. Choose from 50 meticulously abstracted paintings from art history and get to work!

title: The Adventure Story of Yixiu
synopsis: Fantasy RPG that features AP turn-based combat and various RPG nurturing elements, while also offering rich and diverse character storylines that grip the heart.

title: Green Again
synopsis: Green Again is a relaxing colony simulation game. Help a tribe of little plant people reclaim their planet taken over by defective robots. Build, decorate, and expand your settlement. Grow crops for your citizens, explore the unknown, and return the land to its former green state!

title: Overhours
synopsis: From building makeshift traps, to defending her new friends from danger and taking back precious time. Overhours is a single-player action tower defense game set in a dystopian media agency that steals time. One employee, together with an unexpected ghostly partner, is trying to retrieve it all.

title: Derelikt
synopsis: Survive the dark corridors of a space station in Saturns orbit in this narrative retro FPS with faithful PS1 aesthetics. Meet over a dozen unique NPCs, manage your inventory, solve puzzles and fight against the eldritch abominations!

title: La Muraille 1806
synopsis: La Muraille 1806 is a tower defense roguelite set in an alternate 1806, where hordes of Gog and Magog have flooded Europe. The player commands Napoleonic line infantry and artillery holding lines of star forts against tens of thousands of enemies that move like a liquid, flowing around walls and through gaps. Each run deals random battle conditions that change the rules, and campaigns of several battles play out across a map of Europe.

title: Fake Me
synopsis: Model, paint, and blend in! Fake Me is an online multiplayer hide-and-seek game where you create your own disguise. Use simple 3D modeling tools to build the object you’ll hide as. You can also create your own costume by modeling. Hide from the Seekers or find every Faker before time runs out!

title: Fear Night Tales: Camp Story
synopsis: The third game in the Fear Night Tales series takes you to a mysterious camp. Tell the story, live the nightmare. Explore, talk, and choose in a first-person cinematic horror experience.

title: Hidden Squirrels
synopsis:
Get ready for a charming hidden-object adventure in Hidden Squirrels! Explore beautifully detailed black-and-white scenes and search for adorable squirrels hiding in every corner. Look closely, zoom in on the smallest details, and uncover all the sneaky little critters waiting to be found. Every discovery brings you one step closer to transforming the entire illustration into a colorful work of art!

Each environment is packed with tiny details, amusing scenes, and little stories waiting to be discovered. As you find the hidden squirrels in different areas, entire sections of the map burst into vivid color! Watch buildings, streets, and other parts of the scenery come to life as you complete each section. Keep your eyes open, because you might even spot special appearances by characters from other games by the studio!

title: The Coin Keeper: Tidy Up!
synopsis: One dragon sneeze. 6,000 mixed-up coins. Your holiday cancelled. Explore a fantasy museum, inspect coins and find their rightful places in this first-person sorting game. Unlock skills and magical powers to turn a glorious mess into a perfectly organised collection.

title: Upshot
synopsis: Every hit splits them. Every split makes it worse. UPSHOT is a 1–4 player arena shooter where bouncing balls keep breaking into smaller, faster ones. Clear room after room against the clock, open mystery gift boxes and take down a giant boss every fifth room, solo or in co-op.

title: Love in Summer
synopsis: Summer nears. A campus photo job brings you to caring beauty Liu Shilin, aloof yet warm artist Li Feier, mischievous model Xia Wei, and childhood friend Le Tong. Together, you plan graduation shoots, each lending your talents, as your own summer romance with four unique girls quietly begins.

title: Deskpot
synopsis: A mini idle-farming game the size of one pot. Each keystroke turns into water for your little plant. Put it anywhere on your screen, harvest plants and upgrade your pot. While you're busy with other things, your hard work will bear fruit!

title: Toll Idle
synopsis: Build the busiest toll plaza on the road. Start with one cash booth and collect every fare by hand, then grow to ten lanes of automated Tollpass traffic. A relaxing idle game you can finish in about four hours, from quiet mornings to a glowing plaza at night.

title: Sonic Panic
synopsis: Sonic Panic is a 15-player multiplayer game of sound, stealth and deception. Survive up to 3 blind Bosses that hunt through sonic waves, uncover up to 3 hidden Imposters, and vote out anyone you don’t trust.

title: E.G.O. Software Suite
synopsis: Superego Inc. presents the E.G.O. Software Suite: personal applications powered by state-of-the-art inter-universal technology powered by the SUPER Framework. Browse the Universe Wide Web with our flagship Tempest browser or communicate with people across realities.

title: The Cozy Board Game Shop: Tidy Up
originalTitle: The Cozy Board Game Shop: Tidy Up
synopsis: The Cozy Board Game Shop: Tidy Up is a first-person tidying game set in a two-storey board game shop. 3,816 boxes (318 parody board games, twelve copies each) lie scattered around the shop, and the player carries them in stacks and puts each game on its category's shelves. A section is complete when it holds all twelve copies of one game. Shelving boxes and completing sections earns XP, which gives skill points to spend on skills such as revealing loose copies of a game, pulling nearby copies to the player, filling a shelf at once and sorting the carried stack. The 15 categories are spread over the main shop floor, a loft, a greenhouse, a horror room and a detective's office. There are no timers and the game can be saved at any time.

title: Refund Me TD 2
synopsis: A build-your-own-maze tower defence with one dare: clear all 50 levels before your 2-hour refund window closes. Dig a maze into a floating island, draft eight towers, hold off raiders, sappers and balloons. Then lightning, a walking giant and the War Tortoise wreck it. Win, and it asks: refund?

title: Auto Battle Buddies
synopsis: A cozy puppet-show auto battler where you accessorize your heroes with unique gear, build powerful teams, and battle other performers on the grand stage. Customize your puppets, climb the ranks, and create the ultimate Battle Buddies squad.

title: Supermarket: Tidy Up!
synopsis: Tidy up 4970 products your cat knocked off the shelves!

title: Mad Dvizhuha: Benzovoz
synopsis: Mad Dvizhuha: Benzovoz is an online 1v1 multiplayer game in a PS1-inspired low-poly style. One player is a granny with a shotgun driving a fuel tanker across a bridge, fending off attacks with a smoke screen and an electronic jammer. The other player pilots an FPV kamikaze drone and tries to stop the tanker from reaching its destination. Players swap roles every round, while random weather and match modifiers change every run. The game supports keyboard and mouse, gamepads and real FPV radio controllers, and can also be played solo against bots.

title: Voxmons
synopsis:
Voxmons is a creature-collecting action RPG in which the collection does the fighting. Creatures hatched from eggs are equipped into a squad that orbits the player in rings, choosing its own targets and attacking while the player explores. The route runs across four worlds of floating islands - forest, snow, lava and graveyard - linked by bridges and sealed portals, each world ending in a boss, and each island holding its own hatch station with its own egg pool and its own published odds.

187 creatures are spread across seven rarities, each with rarer Large and Huge variants that hit harder and stand taller, and a permanent archive grants lasting bonuses for every species registered in it. Further systems open as the player advances: fusing duplicates into higher tiers, overclocking the rarest creatures, sending reserve creatures on timed expeditions, and leaving the squad to farm while the player is away. It is free to play, with no ads, no currency packs and one optional VIP membership. The artwork was created with generative AI; the game does not generate content with AI while it is played.

title: Vizier
synopsis: The king holds the power — but the words are yours. Advise a young ruler through intrigue, war, and betrayal in a turn-based court drama, where the right counsel shapes a realm and the wrong one ends you.

title: One More Lawn
synopsis: Mow lawns in first person on a beat-up riding mower. You're a grumpy old man who smokes, drinks cheap beer and doesn't care, but leaves perfect stripes. A picky neighbor, an abandoned golf course, an island wedding. Solo or online co-op with up to 6 players.

title: King Dies Rich
synopsis: Defend your throne against undead hordes in a pixel-art siege roguelite. Aim your attacks without leaving your seat, hunt legendary gear, and combine seven schools of power. Turn your spoils into permanent kingdom upgrades. The king will not survive the siege. His gold will.

title: Snow Worries!
synopsis: Santa crashed his sleigh into your garden and Christmas is buried under the snow. Call up to three friends and dig it all out: sell the snow, upgrade from bare cookie hands to absurd machines, and bury each other along the way. Cozy, chaotic co-op with proximity voice chat.

title: Dreadmiles
synopsis: Combine weapon modules, destroy obstacles and spread fire in this claymation rogue-lite horde survivor. Choose your route, take on missions and giant bosses, and head back to your truck before the Seep closes in.

title: Spin Tactics
synopsis: Spin Tactics is a roguelike engine-builder set inside a slot machine. Each spin fills the board with coloured symbols, and connecting three or more of the same colour makes a combo. Gems change a symbol's colour, timing or effect for the rest of the run. More than 90 Companions can be equipped in eight slots, and their order matters, since some boost or copy the Companion next to them. Unwanted Companions, symbols and Gems can be sold in the Black Hole for gold. Each encounter has a score goal and a limited number of Actions, and bosses work against the player. Between runs, credits unlock Chips and Portals that change the starting hero. Runs take 30 to 60 minutes and end on an online leaderboard. There is no real-money gambling and no microtransactions.

title: Tidyspell
synopsis: Tidyspell is a cozy first person magic tidying game. Lift and place every object with your wand, catch invisible thieving spirits, fly on your broom, brew potions and step through doors into rooms that are bigger on the inside.

title: Good President Simulator
synopsis: A satirical political simulation played from a first-person desk. The player runs for office and signs laws by hand, while fifteen factions react to every decision and the next day's newspaper reports on what was signed. Visitors bring favours, gifts and offers, and each law pleases some factions and angers others.

title: Whiskers of Yesterday
synopsis: You're a cat, and the whole house is yours. Bring up to 7 friends: knock plates off the table, play cat football in the garden, swim in the pool, or curl up together in a sunbeam. No timers, no fail states. Just a warm place to be.

title: All Eyes on Me
synopsis: Everyone sees the same thing. Except you. Now every eye is on you. In this bullet heaven roguelite, their attention makes them deadlier and charges your strongest weapon. Find items, shape your build, beat challenges, play local co-op or online conquests.

title: Caramel Creek
synopsis: ☕ Turn a run-down house by the river into a cozy cafe of your own design. Grow and brew your coffee, paint and furnish the place, meet three neighbours with lives of their own - and keep Ostin the cat company. Early Access.

title: Terrahold
synopsis:
Terrahold is a strategy sandbox about building and defending a colony on a living procedural planet. Starting with a teleporter and a single drone, the player explores the world, establishes resource outposts, expands a shared power grid, and develops the colony toward the energy output required to open a permanent tunnel home.
The planet reacts to the colony's expansion through spreading alien vegetation, hostile creatures, eggs, spores, and other environmental threats rather than conventional scripted attack waves. Players can use autonomous robots, defensive structures, force fields, bridges, radar, and terraforming to reshape terrain, protect infrastructure, and expand into hostile territory.

title: Letter Schmetter
synopsis:
In this game you have to form words from an anagram in German. The individual letters bring different points, whereby the rounds become more difficult after each solved turn. The game is available for Twitch and is intended as a community game, since the entire chat is involved.

The name "LetterSchmetter" is a mixture of the English word "Letter" and the German word "Schmetter" (means to bounce something at high speed on a surface).

title: Pool of Madness
synopsis: A horror pool roguelite with upgradable cues, guns and procedural rituals. Shoot some balls. Unleash horrors from beyond. Go insane. Try again.

title: Badass Brigade
synopsis: Throw a dude at another dude! Badass Brigade is a light-hearted 2D action game where you shoot, punch, grab, and throw your foes. Take on missions where you can explore the world and uncover a wide variety of weapons and gear for new ways to fight.

title: Fate/Empire of Dirt: Stella Splendens
synopsis:
The second and last append for Fate/Empire of Dirt, taking places after Made in Heaven and adding new routes for Morgan and Musashi.
Anastasia, Murasaki Shikibu and Consort Yu are also upgrated from sub-heroines to heroines roles.

title: Fate/Empire of Dirt Complete

title: Monster Girls Dice Board
synopsis: On the mysterious Mysteria Island, embark on an exciting dice adventure with charming and unique monster girls! Use strategic board game mechanics to collect resources, buy lands, and compete in friendly matches while building heartwarming bonds and exploring the fantastical island together!

title: Water Maid
synopsis: Water Maid is all about fetching water. Run, jump and dash to avoid enemies and find the elusive fresh water springs scattered around the island. Fill up your pot and make it back to the village, safe and sound.

title: Cafe Simulator
synopsis: Build and manage your cafe business. Customize your shop with furniture and decorations, brew various beverages, serve customers efficiently, expand your space, and compete with rival cafés. Grow from a small shop to a thriving empire. Oh, and there's chicken wrestling too.

title: Snake Echos
synopsis: "Snake Echos: your trail hardens into deadly walls. Loop enemies into your own path, level up with Magnet/Fireball/Scythe abilities, survive escalating chaos with blocks and lasers. Solo leaderboard + Duel mode. 3 difficulty tiers.

title: IWA Fighting Adventure
synopsis: A feature-packed autobattler where you build and develop your own settlement, gather resources, prepare for battle, and lead your forces on dangerous expeditions and auto-battles.

title: Cruisopolis: Cruise Line Tycoon
synopsis: Cruisopolis: Cruise Line Tycoon is a management and building simulation about running a cruise line. Players start with a small river cruiser on the Rhine and work up through the shipyard to a coastal cruiser, a mid-size liner, a resort ship and a megaship, designing each ship's interior deck by deck inside a fixed hull: cabins from interior rooms to balcony suites, dining rooms and buffets, bars, pools, a theatre, a spa, a water park, galleys, stores, the laundry, crew quarters, the engine room and the bridge. They hire and schedule the crew, run power, fresh water, sewage, air conditioning and fuel, plan itineraries on the Rhine, along the Norwegian coast and through the Caribbean, and price cabins for simulated guests who write reviews after each voyage. Ships float on modelled weight and balance, and a sandbox mode can set off events such as a kraken, pirates, lightning storms, rogue waves and capsizes. The game has a six-chapter campaign, a sandbox and a creative mode.

title: How Many Tickets Does It Take To Win The Lottery?
originalTitle: How Many Tickets Does It Take To Win The Lottery?
synopsis: Have you ever wondered, how many tickets does it take to win the lottery? Scratch tickets, match the numbers and spend your winnings on more tickets, until you are scratching millions at a time. The jackpot odds are realistic, 1 in 290,472,336, and nothing you buy changes it.

title: Scopecreep
synopsis: A whispering flame craves souls. With each offering, your resolve strengthens. Fight spirits, collect their essences, and feed a hunger that may never subside in this short active incremental.

title: NodalBastion
synopsis: Defend the last AI core in an abstract minimalist game of incremental progression, powerful skills, and evolving networks.

title: Trees Hate You
synopsis: Hike through the worst forest full of the most horrible trees. Do not trust them. The trees will trick you. They will bully you. They will hurt you. If only you could find an axe...

title: Func Key
synopsis: Func Key is a spelling roguelike deck builder where your keyboard is the deck! Customize your keyboard to be the ultimate spelling machine, or leave words behind with rule breaking mods. Spell, build, and relax, all to the soothing thock of the keyboard.

title: Clicky Islands
synopsis: Clicky Islands is a unique blend of incremental gameplay, clicker mechanics, city-builder elements, and resource management. You play as a governor appointed by the king to discover and develop a new island for his future kingdom.

title: Tekken 8: Roger Jr.
synopsis: Acompanhe o lançamento deste jogo confirmado na base oficial da Twitch / IGDB.

title: Topdeck Automat
synopsis: The roguelike auto-battler where your deck prints itself. Supply a brave worker droid with synergistic blueprints to defend the planet against hordes of alien invaders. Combine hundreds of cards with custom upgrades and infinitely stackable modules to discover broken builds.

title: Highland Haven
synopsis: Discover your own private haven in the Scottish Highlands and bring this once thriving home for hairy “coos” back to life. Craft goodies to sell, optimize your farm, and grow a pasture of cute highland cows roaming free on the bottom of your screen in this relaxing idle game.

title: Dice Looter
synopsis: Roll the dice to collect loot, combine your gear, and discover powerful builds. Dice Looter is a roguelike autobattler where your hero enters battle to become the greatest warrior among mortals.

title: Pegs of Hell
synopsis: A physics roguelike where you build the pachinko board yourself. Place and upgrade pegs, arrange powerful Arcana, split balls, trigger elemental chains and create absurd scoring machines before Hell's rent catches up with you.

title: Raise, Rise & Die
synopsis:
Raise, Rise & Die is a dark fantasy deckbuilder adapted from a physical card game. In solo Arena runs, players face automated enemy decks, collect new cards, and build synergies to climb the leaderboard.
Every card has a Soul Value that determines its cost to play, the Reserve it generates when sacrificed, and the health lost when it falls as the face-up Top Soul. Between battles, sacrificing cards from the deck restores health, creating a choice between preserving a powerful build and surviving the next encounter.
The game also features online one-on-one duels and Ancients’ Path, an editor for creating and sharing custom runs.

title: Who Gave Them Weapons
synopsis: Build your crazy squad in this cartoony auto-battler and watch as it turns into total chaos! Equip teams with the silliest gear, crush friends online, or beat enemies in solo challenges. Mix and match warriors, discover powerful combos, and prove your strategy is more insane than the chaos.

title: Trafficity
synopsis: A city builder focused on traffic. Build out your city with gridless road tools. Fix traffic jams with roundabouts, fully-customizable traffic lights, or sprawling highway interchanges. Keep traffic flowing as you expand to a vast metropolis.

title: Rock and Found
synopsis: Your Grandma has willed you a collection of rocks deep in the woods, but when you arrive, you find that the rocks are strewn across the floor. Armed with your Grandma's journal, a determination to clean the collection, and the tools she left behind, you begin sorting through thousands of rocks.

title: Here Comes the Horde
synopsis: Here Comes the Horde is an auto-battler incremental game where your loyal soldiers fight against hordes of undead enemies led by a formidable necromancer. Earn coins, improve your army, unlock new units, grow stronger, and fill the screen with your troops.

title: Of Dice and Minions
synopsis: Of Dice and Minions is a pixel-art dice-rolling auto-battler roguelite developed and published by Foorbytes. Each turn the player rolls five dice, holding and rerolling them in the style of Yahtzee. Every die represents a minion type, and the number rolled determines how many of that minion are summoned. The resulting poker hand grants a bonus, such as extra units, increased damage or health, or sending all five dice into battle, after which the army fights automatically. A run descends 100 floors across ten zones, with a boss every tenth floor whose own dice rolls summon reinforcements, and continues into an Endless mode after the final floor.

title: My Little Ranch
synopsis: A cozy horse ranch that lives on your desktop while you work, or in full screen when you don't. Feed your horses, send them running together, race for coins, hire ranch hands and grow your ranch.

title: Aurora Requiem: The Lullaby of Calvaris
originalTitle: Aurora Requiem: The Lullaby of Calvaris
synopsis: Year 41 without the sun. Inside the skeleton of a colossal sea creature, the lighthouses burn memories for light. A late-90s-style JRPG with pre-rendered backdrops, three discs, time-gauge battles and a mechanic with a giant wrench who always keeps his word.

title: Dungeonbound
synopsis: Dungeonbound is a retro first-person auto-battler dungeon crawler. Send your Warrior, Mage or Rogue into monster-packed depths, watch battles play out turn by turn, and grow stronger every run. Death just sends you home with the loot. Merge gear, buy upgrades, descend again.

title: Night of the Idle Horde
synopsis: Eat the world in this idle, incremental homage to B-movie horror classics. Start as a lowly Shambler and grow into a massive horde. Recruit evil little critters to automate brain collection and buy upgrades for your army. Unleash a mini apocalypse with Desktop Companion Mode.

title: One More Claw
synopsis: 3D physics claw machine + roguelike building. Land it in the chute; blast the target with base times multiplier.

title: Watermellionaire
synopsis: Watermellionaire is a dark battle royale fruit-matching game. Pitted against other employees, you compete to become the Most Valuable Packer (MVP) - those who fail are fired. Faced with nothing but a box, some fruit and a guard watching your every move, only one person can come out on top.

title: Dreadgence
synopsis: A deterministic horror autobattler. Bind extinct monsters as Pacts, arm them with Rites and Relics, then deploy. Your units fight automatically with no mid-battle commands you win by building the right answer before combat begins. Conquer wounds, deepen your Pacts, and automate what you've mastered.

title: Feed the Vessel
synopsis: A Short Active Incremental game where you grow clones in vats, feed them to the entity, butcher and burn them for meat, blood, and ichor, upgrade your ship's stations, push the engine into overdrive, and reach the other side.

title: White Christmas
synopsis: White Christmas is a cozy multiplayer winter playground set in a snowy village. Build snowmen, trade gifts, rent skates, throw snowballs, and warm up at the Christmas market. Host a village with friends and turn a school-free snow day into shared holiday chaos.

title: The Scratcher
synopsis: A roguelike deckbuilder where your cards are scratch tickets. Scratch to fight, push your luck for the jackpot and stop before you go bust. Build a deck of tickets and climb from the Shantytown to the King's Palace.

title: Chrono Cards
synopsis: Chrono Cards is a digital PVP card game that puts you in the role of a time traveler, summoning cards from across history and manipulating time itself to triumph over your opponent. The game is built around its unique Timeline mechanic which splits the board into Past, Present, and Future regions that move on every turn, forcing players to carefully plan ahead and adapt to a constantly evolving board state.

title: Mizi No!: Hobby Time
synopsis:
We all have hobbies, and so does Mizi! Her favorite hobby? Lovingly undoing whatever you just spent hours creating.

Assembled a miniature mech? Finished a beautiful scrapbook page? Spent all evening crocheting something cute? Haha... yeah, we hope you loved it enough to do it all over again. ;)

The "Hobby Time" DLC adds 20 more items for you to put together all over again.

title: Socks Pair Up
synopsis: Socks Pair Up is a cozy first-person game about pairing up and sorting socks to get a specialty sock shop ready to open. Players match socks by color, pattern, and length, then arrange the pairs on shelves, in boxes, on clips, and on mannequins. Displaying pairs earns rewards and skill upgrades that make sorting and stocking easier, while completing shelves opens more of the shop.

title: No One Owns the Light
synopsis: This is the story of the first person in the world to be put to death in an electric chair.

title: Code Market
synopsis: Your store. Your robot. Your code. Code Market is a relaxed management game where you don't click to sell — you program. A robot works in your supermarket, and it does exactly what your Java code tells it: walk to a rack, pick up tomatoes, take a customer's order, pack the bag.

title: Savebot: The Last Garden
synopsis:
Savebot: The Last Garden is a calm programming game about robots who bring a planet back to life.

The player writes programs, block by block, to teach a few robots that know nothing yet how to take care of a sleeping planet, until life comes back on its own across five worlds.

title: Nullnest
synopsis: Defend the Core in this incremental tower defense. Survive relentless enemy waves, unlock new abilities, and collect gems of different rarities that completely transform each run. Experiment with endless combinations and create unique strategies to overcome ever-growing challenges.

title: Orcthal
synopsis: You are the raid. Play as an orc warrior carving through armies! Auto-cast devastating abilities, level up with powerful perks, loot the fallen, pillage their settlements and come back again, and again, stronger!

title: Trust Me Fellow
synopsis: Trust Me Fellow is a psychological deduction puzzle game in which the player is a blind dealer. The player's cards are hidden from them but visible to an audience of characters, who give hints about what each card is. Some audience members tell the truth and some lie. The goal is to flip every O card; flipping a single X card ends the game.

title: Sort Memes Together
synopsis: A meme store has exploded! Grab, stack and throw 80 meme products with up to 3 friends in online co-op, sort every cat loaf, stonks bust and pet rock onto the right shelf, and turn total brainrot chaos into the tidiest meme shop on the internet.

title: Dawn of Defense
synopsis: Dawn of Defense blends RTS, Tower Defense, and Roguelite progression. In a last defense, lead your tribe against the Empire: Command warriors in battle, fortify defenses, and build an economy as you fight to reclaim your ancestral homeland.

title: Star-Coat
synopsis: Star-Coat is a third person shooter where you dive into procedurally generated maps to fight corrupted enemies and the bosses that command them. Outfit your pilot and your COAT, a fearsome walker, with a variety of weapons and armor to help you defeat evil in the universe.

title: Australia Did It: End-of-the-World Railway Defense Business
originalTitle: Australia Did It: End-of-the-World Railway Defense Business
synopsis: Join our mercenary team: high-risk, low-benefit positions available! Defend cargo trains in this innovative Turn-Based Tower Defense meets Reverse Bullet Hell. Deploy units, merge them to create powerful new types and variations, withstand relentless waves, deliver the goods.

title: Milki Delivery
synopsis: Grab your bike and milk bottles, let's hit the road! Explore the countryside in this short cozy delivery adventure. Befriend folks and gently help them rebuild their community, one bottle at a time. Upgrade your bike, your dairy farm, and venture deeper into a once-lively region.

title: Spellfall: Mages & Mayhem
synopsis: Spellfall: Mages & Mayhem is a fast-paced, top-down PvP arena brawler where up to six mages compete across seven rounds of magical mayhem. Draft new spells and items between rounds, create increasingly powerful builds, and outlast your opponents as the arena crumbles beneath your feet.

title: Okurek
synopsis: Tend the farm, the chickens, the grieving jars. The trees murmur while the cancer grows with every passing day. A 90-min folk-horror experience set in the rotting mountains of Czech Switzerland. Preserve what you couldn't save.

title: Zero Sum
synopsis: A hand-drawn twin-stick roguelite where every bullet is an equation and every enemy is a number. Subtract, divide, root, modulo. 7 operators, 22 firing modes, 9 bosses, 80+ upgrades. Reduce them all to zero. No health bars, just raw arithmetic violence. You failed math class. Math didn't forget.

title: Unicorn Academy: Island of Magic
synopsis: You are invited to join Unicorn Academy! Create a magical connection with your own unicorn and forge friendship bonds with Sophia, Ava, Layla and the other heroes from the series. Wield unicorn magic and discover every corner of Unicorn Island.

title: Night Train Simulator: Blackout
synopsis: A slow-burn psychological horror train simulator. Drive the train. Follow the schedule. Ignore what's outside.

title: Ball Picker: Clean Up the Golf Yard
originalTitle: Ball Picker: Clean Up the Golf Yard
synopsis: Collect +1,000,000 golf balls, earn money, buy new vehicles, and clean up the golf yard. Ball Picker - Clean up the Golf Yard is an active incremental game centered on an organizing and relaxing experience.

title: Uncosy
synopsis: An uncomfortable game about collecting plushies.

title: Monkeys!!
synopsis: A romanti-slapstick comedy visual novel from the creative team at HARUKAZE. Saruyoshi, the world's greatest delinquent, must infiltrate the world's most prestigious school for ladies in order to save his boys'-school comrades!

title: Ratchet & Clank
synopsis: A port of Ratchet & Clank, originally released on PS2, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

title: Steel Gullet
synopsis: Build a massive factory aboard a moving ark. Melt, separate, and refine chaotic scrap using realistic thermodynamics. Process materials by mass instead of items, craft based on material properties, and optimize complex production lines in strictly limited space.

title: Game Shelver 99: I Must Organize My Steam Library and Defend It Against Pirates With a Shotgun
originalTitle: Game Shelver 99: I Must Organize My Steam Library and Defend It Against Pirates With a Shotgun
synopsis: Game Shelver 99 is a satirical first-person organizing game set in a retro PC game store. Sort game boxes onto shelves by genre, tags, year, developer, title, or price, then defend your carefully arranged collection from waves of software pirates. Play solo or team up with up to three friends, or choose a peaceful mode focused entirely on organizing.

title: Dravora
synopsis: A dark fantasy narrative roguelite about three lives on one hard road: a fallen mercenary, an oath-singer's apprentice, and the youngest of three fen brothers. No combat screens. Every choice is made in words, and every choice follows you down the road.

title: Futa: Beer & Sex
synopsis: Futa: Beer & Sex is a fast adult arcade game. The player catches beer to unlock three futa bartenders and an uncensored animated sex gallery. The game contains explicit sexual content.

title: Angel Investor Simulator
synopsis: Invest into promising startups with sometimes wacky ideas. Help them grow with your team of experts. Capture the market share with quality product, smart pricing and marketing. Cash out big after the IPO. Compete with the other angels and show them who's the boss.

title: Legacy of Kain: Soul Reaver 2
synopsis:
A port of Legacy of Kain: Soul Reaver 2, originally released on PlayStation 2, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

In this sequel to the critically acclaimed Legacy of Kain: Soul Reaver, reassume the role of Raziel, and battle back through the currents of time into pivotal, dangerous eras of Nosgoth's past in your relentless pursuit of Kain. Encounter new enemies as you unearth the mysteries of Nosgoth's ancient races, and expose the schemes that lie behind the corruption of the Pillars, and the terrible vampire genocide.

title: Space Station Designer
synopsis: Space Station Designer is a construction and management game that puts you in charge of creating and expanding a network of orbital outposts in Earth and Lunar orbits.

title: Eletta
synopsis: Explore an unfamiliar place filled with powerful enemies, advanced technology and scientific advancements in Eletta, an action game about a young girl looking for a way back home.

title: Vice: Magic City Mayhem
synopsis: Vice: Magic City Mayhem is a retro action-adventure game where you fight, collect new items, and upgrade your character as you make your way through bustling nightclubs, scenic beaches, and raptor-infested yachts.

title: Graveyard Orbit
synopsis: A satisfying incremental where you build the ultimate mining ship, loot every piece of an alien megastructure, and upgrade your abilities with an array of unlockable parts and skill trees. MINE. BUILD. UPGRADE. REPEAT.

title: Toto's Journey
synopsis: Toto’s Journey is a cozy adventure inspired by the world of The Wizard of Oz. Play as Toto, a brave dog lost in a magical world after a mysterious cyclone. Explore enchanted lands, meet unusual creatures, and solve environmental puzzles as you search for a way back home.

title: Dark Rail
synopsis: Turn-based management roguelike. Command the Inquisition and rule an industrial city on the empire’s edge. Use your train to meet prisoner shipment quotas by hunting heretics and slaying magical beasts. Produce supplies, contain revolt, and sacrifice prisoners to stop the madness.

title: Marque & Reprisal
synopsis: Explore. Trade. Fish. Whale. Colonize. Fight. Pillage. Survive. You are a sea captain in the year 1522, and the whole world is yours to discover in this roguelike sandbox historical sailing simulator.

title: Disney Dreamlight Valley: The Keepsake Sea
originalTitle: Disney Dreamlight Valley: The Keepsake Sea
synopsis: Become a magical mermaid and plunge into the waters of the Keepsake Sea! Uncover what secrets lie beneath the waves and embark on a thrilling new ocean adventure.

title: Frog is Crime
synopsis: good criminal open world game of 2026. drive cars, commit crime, kill peoples and become crime king in world of humans as frog

title: Whitopia
synopsis: Experience pure calm through a short relaxing 3D painting simulation. Cover graffiti, clutter, and anything colorful in pure white. Earn rewards, unlock upgrades, and become more efficient as you restore a world where white is the only color allowed to exist.

title: Please Confirm the Deceased
synopsis: Psychological horror at a morgue's night intake desk. Bodies arrive with paperwork that has to match the body. Weigh it, measure it, take its temperature listen to its chest. Some still have a pulse. The rulebook gains a page every night, and some of what you sign in does not stay signed in.

title: Bomb Them Ores
synopsis: Bomb Them Ores is a short arcade incremental mining game. Explode caves, collect minerals and unlock upgrades to delve deeper!

title: Strato Alto
synopsis:
Strato Alto is a 3D aerial combat action rogue-like game.

Features two game modes, Classic and Journey.

Classic is an arcadey timed round survival mode. Down enemies, choose upgrades, and gain currency to unlock new planes and equipment for future rounds.

Journey mode is a rogue-lite campaign. Outfit and upgrade your aircraft as you journey across three world maps in pursuit of the legendary Red Baron to prove your own mastery of the stratosphere!
